{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with cleaned revenue
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue_clean', ascending=False)
total_revenue_by_channel"}
